queries.sql: SELECT tablename, indexname, indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename = ANY(%s) ORDER BY tablename, indexname
SELECT tablename, indexname, indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename = ANY(%s) AND indexdef LIKE 'CREATE UNIQUE%%' ORDER BY tablename, indexname
SELECT conrelid::regclass::text AS table_name, conname, pg_get_constraintdef(oid) AS definition FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid::regclass::text = ANY(%s) AND contype IN ('c','u') ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT indexname, indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='library_documents' AND indexdef LIKE '%source_sha256%' ORDER BY indexname
SELECT status, count(*) AS documents FROM library_documents GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
SELECT count(*) AS chunks_without_document FROM library_document_chunks c LEFT JOIN library_documents d ON d.id=c.document_id WHERE d.id IS NULL
SELECT count(*) AS pages_without_run FROM library_pages_v2 p LEFT JOIN library_ingestion_runs_v2 r ON r.run_id=p.run_id WHERE r.run_id IS NULL
